item.title: Iran live updates: Tehran awaits US response to 7-point proposal
item.description: President Donald Trump announced major combat operations against Iran on Feb. 28.

item.title: Leading AI figures to convene at White House
item.description: The gathering follows warnings from AI leaders about the technology's risks and calls to slow its development before it surpasses human intelligence.

item.title: Hurricane Polo strikes Baja California, life-threatening winds forecast
item.description: Hurricane Polo made landfall in Baja California, bringing flash flooding and winds that forecasters described as life-threatening.

item.title: U.S. ban on nearly $1 billion in Canadian imports begins
item.description: The United States has barred nearly $1 billion in Canadian imports, including alcoholic beverages, dairy products and motorcycles.
